entries.excerpt: The EVM deducts the full gas limit at the start of execution and applies gas refunds only at the end. If the gas limit is set too tightly (equal to the actual gas used before refunds), the refund cannot be processed and the transaction fails with an out-of-gas error. Fix: set the gas limit slightly higher than the expected gas usage.
entries.title: FAQs — why a transaction fails with out-of-gas on Pharos

entries.excerpt: RPC: official public endpoint for basic dev/testing, ZAN as production default, Alchemy as alternative, Nirvana also available. Oracles: Chainlink default (Push Engine feeds for automatic on-chain reactions, Data Feeds for low-latency pull). Cross-chain: Chainlink CCIP first (documented live Pharos-Ethereum lane), Circle CCTP for native USDC, LayerZero alternative. Wallets: Safe MultiSig, Fordefi MPC custody. EVM development: Foundry or Hardhat. Standing rule: do not rely on memorized network parameters, contract addresses, or gas values — confirm against the Live Data pages.
